text:
Marta: Heads up — Orbitex interview scheduled with Jordan (PM) next Wed 10am PT. Need assets: quote, logo, headshot, legal OK by Tue EOD.
Devon: I can handle recording + edit. Zoom or Riverside?
Priya: Zoom is fine. I’ll draft the Qs and a short customer quote.
Lex: Can we get the shadow copy of the quote here? Need to make sure it's non-PII.
Priya: Draft quote (v0):
```
"Switching to Redwood Inference cut our inference costs by ~40% and improved 95th pct latency from 400ms to 120ms."
```
Marta: Nice start. @Sara_Legal can you review for claims and embargo language? We need legal signoff before we share with Jordan.
Sara_Legal: On it. Quick note — avoid % without backup doc and revise 'cut our inference costs' -> 'reduced per-token cost'. Also need customer attribution consent.
Priya: Updated quote:
"After moving to Redwood Inference, OrbitalX reduced per-token costs by ~40% and improved 95th percentile latency from ~400ms to ~120ms."
Marta: @Devon once approved, can you record the session and capture a 15–30s excerpt for social? :thumbsup:
Devon: Yep. I'll add an action item to the calendar invite and include recording consent language.
publish-bot: Reminder: embargo window until 2025-10-10 08:00 UTC. Do not publish earlier.
Marta: Timeline check — Tue EOD legal ok, Wed interview, Thurs asset prep, Fri publish draft to review.
Lex: I'll route the quote to comms once Sara signs off. Also need logo high-res from customer — @Marta pls confirm.
Marta: Reaching out to Jordan for logo and headshot now. Sending draft quote for customer approval after legal ok.
Priya: Thanks — I'll lock Qs and call flow. Will post final assets here.
Sara_Legal: Signed off pending customer approval. See minor redlines on doc: https://docs.redwood.com/marketing/orbitex-quote-v2
Marta: Great. Everyone — please mark your calendar. I'll update thread when Jordan confirms assets.
